authority: NONE: information only. The model cannot create, cancel or modify a BUY/SELL/WAIT decision.

task.name: future_log_range
task.decision_time: close of H1 bar t (features use bars <= t only)
task.unit: natural log of a price ratio (dimensionless)

features.name: lATR14
features.missing_rule: row excluded until lookback is complete; no imputation
features.normalization: ln(SMA(TrueRange,14)[t] / Close[t]); SMA of true range, not Wilder

features.missing_rule: row excluded until lookback is complete; no imputation

features.missing_rule: row excluded until lookback is complete; no imputation

features.name: lBBW
features.missing_rule: row excluded until lookback is complete; no imputation
features.rationale: band width as a volatility state (descriptive; the squeeze-expansion claim was rejected)

models.promotion_of_challenger: only if the 95% block-bootstrap CI of (MSE_default - MSE_challenger) is above 0 on Validation AND on Test-H

baselines.definition: expanding mean of the training label
OLS of the label on lATR14 only, refit per fold
label mean by 5 buckets of the 250-bar ATR14 percentile, refit per fold

splits.scheme: chronological only; random shuffling is forbidden
splits.train: all rows with decision time <= start_of_fold - embargo (expanding window; first test year 2012)
splits.calibration: the most recent 25% of each fold's training rows, separated from the fit rows by the embargo
splits.note: Development 2011-2018 and Validation 2019-2021 are burned for descriptive measurements (Class D); the official V0 run re-executes this frozen spec.

metrics.primary: MSE of ln range (out of sample)

RESEARCH_to_VALIDATED_OFFLINE: MSE improvement versus atr14_one_feature >= 5% with the lower bound of the 95% monthly block-bootstrap CI > 0 on Validation
80% interval coverage within 75%..85% on Validation and Test-H
improvement positive in >= 75% of test years

interval.method: empirical quantiles of out-of-fold residuals from the calibration window

display.show: expected next-24h range in USD and the 80% interval, only when model status >= SHADOW and the model is healthy
v0_uses: hint that expected range is small versus cost (stand-aside hint)
display.v0_authority: none: no use may cancel or authorise a trade

forbidden: tuning hyper-parameters on Validation or Test-H
using Test-H or Holdout before the owner approves the K policy and the run

k_accounting.candidate_note: Ridge/HAR is ONE candidate (ridge regression on the HAR-style volatility features); LightGBM is the other. The three baselines are reference points, not candidates, and consume no K.
k_accounting.selection_stage: confirmatory evaluation on Test-H (one run); Validation is Class D and consumes no K
k_accounting.ci_note: On Test-H each candidate-versus-baseline comparison is judged at the K-adjusted two-sided 97.5% level (Bonferroni, alpha/K). Validation reports both 95% and 97.5%.
k_accounting.adding_a_candidate: forbidden under this family: a new candidate, hyper-parameter variant chosen by results, task or timeframe needs a new ADR and family BEFORE any confirmatory result is seen
k_accounting.reason: ADR-V2-007 (locked 2026-10-13): K per family, 44 not inherited

amendment_rule: A frozen spec is never edited in place. A change is a new spec_version with an owner-approved reason, and the guard hash in ml_v0_spec.sha256 is replaced in the same commit.

amendment.approved_by: project owner (message of 2026-10-13: ADR-V2-007 approved, K locked per family, G6 ML V0 next)
amendment.reason: ADR-V2-007 locked the K policy: the selection candidates and the K accounting must be written into the spec before any confirmatory result is seen. Task, label, features, models, splits, metrics, interval and promotion criteria are unchanged (a test proves it).
